description: What a host process says back when it can't do what it's asked (shown by the app that asked: Baude, Record, Emission or the Android app).

messages.trash_failed: {$path} couldn't be moved to the trash: {$why}
messages.trash_failed_some: {$path} couldn't be moved to the trash: {$why} ({$moved} moved already)
messages.feedback_no_target: this host can't tell where to file it: is its gh signed in?
messages.feedback_filing: it's being filed already: try again in a moment
messages.browser_on_phone: this Bot's browser is on a phone now: it's shown there
messages.at_a_turn: it's at a turn: stop it, or wait for its end, first
messages.senders_unreadable: its sender store couldn't be read: see the host's log
messages.no_held: no such message held for it
messages.routine_limit: set is a routine (a Bot has 50 at most)
messages.no_routine: no such routine (or its Bot's archived)
messages.picture_too_big: the picture is too big (2 MB at most)
messages.memory_changed: the Bot changed its memory since it was read
messages.fork_folder: a fork runs in its session's folder: {$path}
messages.cant_run: {$host} can't run {$model}: it, or its program, isn't here
messages.no_adopt_source: no conversation {$session} here to take up
messages.other_model: another kind of model can't carry this conversation on: start a session with it
messages.rewind_missing: that message isn't in this chat's record
messages.not_in_session_folder: not in one of its sessions' folders
messages.not_session_folder: not one of its sessions' folders
messages.notebooks_too_big: its notebooks are too big to send
messages.changes_not_taken: the Record running there didn't take the changes
messages.another_phone: another phone shows this Bot's browser now
messages.no_such_bot: that's no Bot of this host's
messages.not_task_output: not a background task's output in that session
messages.active_elsewhere: This session is currently active elsewhere: send it again once it's done
